title: C: Observable Stream
description: Create an observable data stream with transform operators (map, filter) that process data through a pipeline.

steps.title: Observable with Map/Filter
steps.description: Define a `Stream` struct with a function pointer for the source and a next stream pointer. Implement `Stream* stream_from_array(int *arr, int len)`. Implement `Stream* stream_map(Stream *prev, int (*fn)(int))` and `Stream* stream_filter(Stream *prev, int (*pred)(int))`. Create a pipeline: array -> map(double) -> filter(>5) -> collect.
hints: Each stream node has a `next` pointer forming a pipeline.
source stream iterates over the array.
map transforms each value, filter skips values.
Base stream type: struct with run function pointer.

verification.failureMessage: Collect and print all values from the stream
